name: Can I inspect my own roof for wind damage?

mainEntity.name: Can I inspect my own roof for wind damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: While you can visually check your roof from the ground for obvious signs of damage, a professional inspection is recommended for safety and thoroughness. Climbing onto a damaged roof can be dangerous, and a professional can identify subtle or hidden issues that might be missed by an untrained eye. Discounted Roofing Co. has the expertise to safely assess all roof damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: While you can visually check, a professional inspection is safer and more thorough for identifying hidden wind damage.
